summary: Reads two DWORD fields from the global object pointed to by dword_8B8DC8 (offsets +28/0x1C and +32/0x20) into caller-supplied output pointers and returns the global pointer itself. Existing analysis attributes the fields to a render device and interprets them as viewport/render-surface dimensions (DERIVED); the raw source proves only the two unconditional reads.

operations.description: Write to *a1 the DWORD read at dword_8B8DC8 + 28 (0x1C).
Write to *a2 the DWORD read at dword_8B8DC8 + 32 (0x20).
Return dword_8B8DC8, the global pointer itself.

unresolved: The meaning of the two fields at global+0x1C and global+0x20 as viewport/render-surface dimensions is taken from existing_analysis (DERIVED); only the unconditional reads are proven by the raw source. The global offsets 28 and 32 appear in the raw source only and have no packet field evidence_ref.
dword_8B8DC8 is read but never validated before dereference in this function.
